'''''Get'shuk''''' was a fast-paced [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] sport. Similar in many ways to the game of [[Limmie/Legends|bolo-ball]], ''get'shuk'' was played by teams of multiple players on a large field known as a pitch. Situated at either end of the pitch were goals wherein competitors would attempt to deliver a ball; unlike in bolo-ball, ''get'shuk'' players were allowed to handle the ball with [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] other than just their feet.<ref name="Mando'a" />

While in his youth, the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Mij Gilamar]] had his [[Nose/Legends|nose]] broken during an intense game of ''get'shuk''. Left with a crook in the bridge of his nose that stayed with him well into middle age, friends of Gilamar noted that the injury gave the typically good-natured [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] a more brutish outward appearance than one would expect.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Get'shuk'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']]'','' the fourth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]]. Written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], the novel was published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The dictionary of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] compiled by Traviss also provided further details on the Mandalorian game, comparing it to the real-world sport of [[Wikipedia:Rugby football|rugby]].<ref name="Mando'a" />
